news.title: Range Resources Sets Q2 2025 Earnings Date
news.text: Range Resources announced it would report second-quarter 2025 results on July 30 with a call the following day.

news.title: Investor Presentation Outlines Three-Year Plan
news.text: Range Resources released investor materials detailing growth projections and capital strategy through 2027.

news.title: Roth Capital Downgrades to Neutral
news.text: Roth Capital downgraded Range Resources from Buy to Neutral and cut its price target to $35.

news.title: UBS Trims Price Target, Keeps Neutral
news.text: UBS reduced its price target while maintaining a Neutral stance as gas price volatility weighed on outlook.

news.title: Braced Tube Foundation Reviewed by DNV
news.text: Range Resources said DNV reviewed its Braced Tube Foundation with a first prototype slated to break ground in China.

news.title: Quarterly Dividend Maintained
news.text: The board declared a quarterly dividend of $0.09 per share, payable in September.

news.title: Truist Upgrades Range Resources to Buy
news.text: Truist Securities upgraded the stock from Hold to Buy and lifted its price target to $47.

news.title: Raymond James Raises Target to $50
news.text: Raymond James reiterated a Strong Buy rating and increased its target price to $50 following commodity updates.

news.title: Q3 2025 Results Miss Expectations
news.text: Range Resources posted a $0.09 per-share loss on $590 million revenue, missing analyst estimates and pressuring shares.

news.title: Analysts Cut Targets After Q3 Miss
news.text: Several analysts, including Stifel Nicolaus, trimmed price targets while maintaining positive ratings after the earnings miss.
